Body.Content:
Dynamics 365 Project Operations streamlines transaction processing by replacing separate transaction origin records with direct source document references on transaction records, including journal lines, actuals, and invoice line details. This approach reduces the database operations required to maintain links to originating time entries, expenses, and material usage logs, and enables the phased retirement of transaction origin record creation.

GA date: December CY2026

Preview date: April CY2026
